content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Online gumroad

Conventional platforms like Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle offer rented convenience. They handle hosting, payment processing, and delivery in exchange for a percentage of your revenue. Stripe and PayPal are the payment backbone of these platforms. If either fails or excludes your country, the entire stack collapses. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, by contrast, is ownership-based. It uses GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. NOWPayments handles crypto payments with a 0.5% fee and no KYC. You own every layer. No platform can suspend your account or hold your funds.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle are built on top of Stripe and PayPal. If Stripe doesn’t operate in your country, these platforms are unusable. Even if PayPal is available, a single policy change or account suspension can freeze your business. Sovereign infrastructure bypasses these centralized payment layers entirely. It uses on-chain crypto payments verified automatically via webhooks. Buyers don’t need an account—they pay directly from their wallet. The system works in every country because it’s built on open networks, not corporate policies. Your store operates on infrastructure you control, not platforms that can exclude you.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Gumroad charges 10% per sale. Lemon Squeezy and Paddle take 5-10%. Stripe and PayPal add 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction. If your country is restricted, these fees are irrelevant—you can’t use them. Sovereign infrastructure uses NOWPayments, which charges 0.5% per transaction. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON keep transaction fees under $0.10. Payments confirm on-chain within minutes, and the webhook triggers instant product delivery. There are no monthly subscriptions or hidden costs. Once deployed, the stack operates indefinitely with zero recurring fees.
Sovereign infrastructure is not a workaround—it’s a permanent base-layer alternative to rented platforms.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, or Paddle, your business lives on someone else’s platform. They control your data, your customer relationships, and your ability to operate. Sovereign infrastructure gives you full ownership. Your store runs on your GitHub or Cloudflare account. Orders are stored in your Supabase database or Google Sheet. Files are delivered from your Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 bucket. Automation is handled by your backend logic—not a third-party API. Once deployed, COREMERCH has no access to your stack. You own it, control it, and scale it without permission.

If you’re in a country Stripe or PayPal excludes, conventional platforms are not an option. Even if they were, the risk of account suspension or policy changes makes them unreliable. Sovereign commerce infrastructure is the only permanent solution. It’s not a workaround—it’s a structural alternative built at the base layer.
